about_the_game:
"There's a rumor about those red shoes. They're said to have a curse that will make you run until you die if you put them on. But let's think about it the other way around... If I somehow steal them, no one will be able to catch me, right?"

Wear red shoes and keep running! Rush Rush Red Shoes is a rogue-lite shooting racing game where you attack enemies by increasing your movement speed.

* Game Features

Rush Rush Red Shoes offers four game modes:

Story mode lets you follow the overall story of the game. Follow the great adventure of Cedric, who stole the red shoes!

Survival Mode is a mode where you can freely roam the stages from Story Mode and survive for as long as you can. You can obtain the resources needed for upgrades here!

Time Attack Mode is a mode where you have to complete some stages in a short amount of time. Try to complete the stages as quickly as possible!

Hardcore mode is an enhanced version of Survivor mode. If you work hard to clear Survivor mode, you might be able to play it someday?!

* How to operate

The game is controlled by using the arrow keys. If you continue to move in one direction, your speed will increase and you will be able to attack. When you reach the maximum speed, it is MAXSPEED! If you continue to attack enemies and maintain the maximum speed, the player will become closer to invincibility.

Use a combination of different abilities and delicate controls to push away the constantly swarming guards and keep running away!
